correctness.rationale: Full positive resource-origin decomposition follows from the exact source process; by symmetry each marked birth intensity is theta/m times the consumption of its source, each source has a deterministic finite consumed-mass budget, and independent Poisson time-change processes give the pathwise Poisson(theta) offspring forest. Independent exponential death clocks and the population occupation identity imply extinction time <= total potential lifetime. The PGF singularity is z_c=e^(theta-1)/theta, giving q*=delta(1-theta e^(1-theta)); the critical identity -log(1-u)-u=log(1+1/(delta t)) gives u<=sqrt(2/(delta t)). A fresh standalone program passed 52 algebraic/series checks. Numerics do not replace the analytical proof; only one-sided bounds are proved.

value.rationale: An explicit marked-source ancestry controls an interacting spatial population by an independent branching forest, a structural fact not supplied by an almost-sure extinction martingale. It delivers finite-time upper bounds uniform in dimension and interaction geometry, with explicit subcritical exponential moments and a quantified critical \(t^{-1/2}\) bound, directly addressing a natural quantitative gap in a recent sharp survival-threshold result.
